title: Nashville Serenity. Downtown Condo w/ Water View!
description:
Stay in the heart of Music City! This charming 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo is just a short walk to Broadway, where you’ll find legendary honky-tonks, live music, rooftop bars, and unforgettable nightlife. Also within walking distance are the Nashville Farmers Market, Sounds Stadium, Nissan Stadium, Bicentennial Park, and some of the city’s best local eats—no car needed!

Fast Wifi, Free Parking, Fully Stocked Kitchen and a Beautiful River view for a relaxing stay in Nashville.

The space
Kick off your boots and settle into this cozy 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom riverfront condo—your home base in the heart of Nashville! With a king-size bed in the bedroom, a comfy daybed, and a memory foam, this space sleeps up to 6 guests with room to relax after a night on the town.

The full kitchen is stocked with everything you need—pots, pans, dishes, utensils, and fresh coffee—so you can whip up a Southern breakfast or reheat your hot chicken leftovers from Broadway.

The open living room has a laid-back vibe with a smart TV, fast WiFi, and plenty of space to kick back between adventures. Step outside to your private balcony, sip your coffee, and take in peaceful views of the Cumberland River.

As a guest, you’ll also have access to a seasonal outdoor pool and a full workout center—perfect for burning off that barbecue. Free parking, fresh linens, towels, and hotel-style essentials are all included to make your stay smooth and stress-free.

Come catch the wonderful Vibes of Music City!

Guest access
Guest has full private access to the condo. Guest shares access to the community pool and workout facility and all common grounds.

Other things to note
This condo was just professionally painted and has had some improvements made. I am waiting professional photos, so some of the photos may be outdated until I get the new ones.
